The ping is a side branch

The custom Healthchecks node returns only an error if the service refuses a ping. In the data path that would replace the lead, so it sits beside the path and a failed ping never costs a lead.

5 of 5

runs finished when five mails arrived at the same second. Healthchecks refused some pings, no lead was lost.
